reports.title: Regulations for the Implementation of the Statistics Law of the People's Republic of China
reports.publisher: State Council
reports.description: Administrative regulations issued pursuant to the Statistics Law. Detail the organisation and management of statistical surveys, approval and filing of statistical survey projects, statistical standards, data quality control, publication of statistical data, and statistical supervision. Clarify responsibilities of statistical institutions at various levels and the obligations of survey respondents. Current version adopted 2017 and effective from 1 August 2017; operationalises the legal framework for NBS and other government statistical work.

reports.title: China Statistical Yearbook (中国统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Flagship annual statistical compendium comprehensively reflecting China's economic and social development. Covers national and provincial-level data for the preceding year across approximately 28 chapters including general survey, population, national accounts, employment and wages, prices, people's livelihoods, government finance, resources and environment, energy, fixed-asset investment, international trade, agriculture, industry, construction, wholesale and retail, transport, finance, real estate, science and technology, education, health, culture and sports. Includes historical series for key indicators and selected data for Hong Kong SAR, Macao SAR and Taiwan Province. Published in Chinese and English; typically released in September. Serves as the primary official reference volume for a wide range of indicators.

reports.title: Statistical Communiqué of the People's Republic of China on the National Economic and Social Development
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Authoritative annual overview of major economic and social developments for the preceding year. Released in late February. Covers GDP and industrial structure, agriculture, industry, investment, domestic trade, foreign trade and economic cooperation, public finance, banking, transport, post and telecommunications, tourism, education, science and technology, culture, health, social services, population, people's living standards, social security, resources, environment and safety. Provides preliminary annual figures that are later refined in the China Statistical Yearbook and final national accounts verification. Primary high-visibility official summary of national performance.
title_aliases: 国民经济和社会发展统计公报

reports.title: Gross Domestic Product and National Accounts (GDP)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Core national accounts framework compiled in accordance with China's System of National Accounts (CSNA 2016), aligned with the United Nations SNA 2008. Produces annual and quarterly GDP by production approach (value added of primary, secondary and tertiary industries, with finer industry breakdowns), expenditure approach components, and related aggregates. Quarterly GDP released approximately 15 days after quarter-end on a discrete basis (since 2015). Annual figures undergo preliminary accounting followed by final verification. Historical series revised after major censuses (most recently the Fifth National Economic Census for 2023). Constant-price series use a fixed base (currently 2020). Serves as the central macroeconomic aggregate for China.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) (居民消费价格指数)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Official measure of changes in the prices of a fixed basket of consumer goods and services purchased by urban and rural households. Compiled as a chained Laspeyres index. Base year updated every five years (most recent rotation to 2025, with first releases under the new base in early 2026). Covers eight major categories and approximately 268 basic classes. Prices collected from roughly 120 000 outlets and over 600 000 representative specifications nationwide. Monthly releases typically around the 9th–10th of the following month. Urban and rural sub-indices and detailed category breakdowns published. Primary indicator of consumer inflation used for policy analysis and indexation.

reports.title: Value-added of Industry (Industrial Production) above Designated Size
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Key high-frequency indicator of industrial output measuring the year-on-year growth rate of value added of industrial enterprises above designated size (principal business revenue threshold). Covers mining, manufacturing, and production and supply of electricity, heat, gas and water. Monthly releases typically mid-month for the preceding month, with cumulative year-to-date figures. Sectoral and ownership breakdowns (state-owned, private, etc.) and selected high-tech/equipment manufacturing series provided. Major input into quarterly and annual national accounts production-side estimates and short-term economic monitoring.

reports.title: National Population Census (and 1% Population Sample Surveys)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) / Office of the Leading Group of the State Council for the National Population Census
reports.description: Decennial full-enumeration population census providing comprehensive data on population size, structure (age, sex, ethnicity, education, employment, household type), distribution, urban-rural composition and migration. Seventh National Population Census conducted with reference time 00:00 hours on 1 November 2020; main results released May 2021. Supplementary 1% National Population Sample Surveys conducted in inter-censal years (most recent 2025). Governed by the Regulations on National Population Census. Results form the benchmark for annual population estimates, demographic analysis and many socio-economic indicators published in the Statistical Yearbook and Communiqué.

reports.title: Household Income and Expenditure / People's Livelihoods Statistics
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Recurring household survey-based statistics on per capita disposable income, consumption expenditure, income distribution, poverty-related indicators and living conditions of urban and rural residents. Principal source for the 'People's Livelihoods' chapter of the China Statistical Yearbook and for key figures in the annual Statistical Communiqué. Provides the expenditure weights used in CPI basket construction and informs national accounts household consumption estimates. Data released quarterly and annually with urban/rural and regional breakdowns.

reports.title: Money Supply and Financial Statistics (M0, M1, M2 and related)
reports.publisher: People's Bank of China (PBOC)
reports.description: Monthly monetary aggregates and related financial statistics compiled and released by the People's Bank of China. Core series include currency in circulation (M0), narrow money (M1 – revised definition from January 2025 to include personal demand deposits and non-bank payment institution client reserves), and broad money (M2). Accompanying data cover RMB and foreign-currency loans and deposits, aggregate financing to the real economy (social financing scale), and selected central-bank balance-sheet items. Released in the monthly Financial Statistics Report. Primary high-frequency monetary indicator set for China.

reports.title: Balance of Payments (国际收支平衡表)
reports.publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
reports.description: Quarterly and annual balance-of-payments statistics compiled according to BPM6 standards. Covers the current account (goods, services, primary income, secondary income), capital account and financial account, together with the international investment position. Preliminary quarterly data released approximately 6–8 weeks after quarter-end; annual data and revisions follow. Detailed time-series and analytical reports (China's Balance of Payments Report) published on the SAFE website. Complements NBS external-trade and national-accounts data and forms the official external-sector accounts for China.

reports.title: Producer Price Index for Industrial Products (PPI) (工业生产者出厂价格指数)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly index measuring changes in the ex-factory prices of industrial products. Covers mining, manufacturing and utilities. Includes means of production and consumer goods sub-indices, as well as the related Purchasing Price Index for Industrial Producers. Compiled from surveys of approximately 50 000 enterprises. Base year currently 2020 (updated every five years in parallel with CPI). Released around the 9th–10th of the following month. Key leading indicator of inflationary pressure and industrial cost conditions; input into national accounts and industrial analysis.

reports.title: Investment in Fixed Assets (excluding rural households)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly cumulative series measuring capital expenditure on construction and purchase of fixed assets by enterprises, institutions and government units (excluding rural household investment). Broken down by industry (primary/secondary/tertiary), ownership, region, and selected infrastructure categories. Includes intellectual-property-products investment. Major high-frequency indicator of domestic demand and capital formation; feeds into GDP expenditure-side estimates and quarterly national accounts. Released mid-month for the preceding cumulative period.

reports.title: Total Retail Sales of Consumer Goods
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly indicator of domestic consumption measuring the sum of retail sales of consumer goods sold by all sectors to urban and rural residents and social groups. Includes breakdowns by urban/rural area, goods vs catering, online retail sales of goods and services, and enterprises above designated size. Key high-frequency proxy for household consumption and domestic demand. Released mid-month together with industrial production and fixed-asset investment.

reports.title: Investment in Real Estate Development
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly series on investment by real-estate development enterprises, floor space under construction, newly started and completed, sales of commercial buildings (area and value), and sources of funds. Distinct from the broader Fixed-Asset Investment series; property investment is a major and often volatile component of overall FAI. Critical for monitoring the property sector, which has been a significant drag on recent investment growth. Released mid-month.

reports.title: China Energy Statistical Yearbook (中国能源统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) – Department of Energy Statistics
reports.description: Annual comprehensive compilation of energy production, consumption, conversion efficiency, investment, balance tables (national and regional), and related indicators. Covers primary energy total and by fuel (coal, oil, gas, electricity including hydro, nuclear, wind, solar), industrial terminal consumption by sector, and energy intensity relative to GDP. Principal official source for detailed energy balances and long-term energy series. Published by China Statistics Press; data typically lag the reference year by one year.

reports.title: Bulletin on the National Grain Production
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Annual (and seasonal) official bulletin reporting total grain sown area, yield per unit area and total production, with breakdowns by season (summer grains, early rice, autumn grains) and major cereals (rice, wheat, maize). Based on nationwide surveys across all 31 provinces. Released in December for the calendar year. Core agricultural output indicator used in the Statistical Communiqué, Yearbook and national accounts primary-industry estimates. Complements broader agricultural statistics systems.

reports.title: Customs Statistics on Imports and Exports of Goods
reports.publisher: General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China (GAC)
reports.description: Monthly and annual merchandise trade statistics compiled on a customs basis. Covers total import and export values (in RMB and USD), trade by regime (ordinary trade, processing trade, etc.), partner countries/regions, and major commodity categories. Released monthly with detailed tables; annual reviews also published. Primary source for China's goods trade data used in Balance of Payments (goods account), national accounts net exports, and the Statistical Communiqué / Yearbook. Distinct from BOP ownership-transfer adjustments.

reports.title: National Expenditures on Science and Technology / R&D Expenditure Statistics
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) jointly with Ministry of Science and Technology and Ministry of Finance
reports.description: Annual statistical communiqué and detailed tables on research and experimental development (R&D) expenditure, intensity (R&D/GDP), breakdown by activity type (basic research, applied research, experimental development), by performing sector (enterprises, government research institutes, higher education), by region and by high-technology industries. Also covers national fiscal science and technology expenditure. Released typically in September–October for the preceding year (preliminary estimates earlier). Principal official measure of China's innovation investment effort.

reports.title: China Ecological and Environmental Statistical Yearbook / Status Bulletin and Statistical Annual Report
reports.publisher: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) jointly with National Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Recurring official environmental statistics covering air quality (PM2.5, good-air days), surface-water quality (proportion of Grade I–III sections), coastal waters, soil, solid waste, natural ecology (forest coverage, grassland), pollution emissions (COD, ammonia nitrogen, SO2, NOx, particulates), environmental investment, and carbon-related indicators. Includes the annual China Ecological and Environmental Status Bulletin and the more detailed Ecological and Environmental Statistical Annual Report / Yearbook. Provides the core data for environmental chapters of the China Statistical Yearbook and for green-development monitoring.

reports.title: Energy Production (monthly)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly release of major energy production indicators including raw coal, crude oil, natural gas and electricity generation (thermal, hydro, nuclear, wind, solar). Part of the regular mid-month economic data package. Provides high-frequency monitoring of energy supply that complements the annual Energy Statistical Yearbook balances and feeds into industrial and GDP analysis.

reports.title: Gross Regional Product (Provincial GDP) Series
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Annual (and in some cases quarterly) series of Gross Regional Product for the 31 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government. Compiled under the unified national accounts framework (CSNA). Since around 2019 NBS has strengthened central coordination of provincial GDP to reduce discrepancies with national totals. Published in the China Statistical Yearbook, National Data platform and provincial communiqués. Provides the official provincial-level aggregate for vertical comparison with national GDP and for regional analysis.

reports.title: Guangdong Statistical Yearbook (广东统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Guangdong Provincial Bureau of Statistics / NBS Guangdong Survey Office
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook of Guangdong Province, the largest provincial economy by GDP. Covers provincial and municipal/county data on national accounts, population, employment, investment, foreign trade, industry, energy, prices, living standards, agriculture and social statistics. Continuously published since the mid-1980s; electronic version released on the provincial statistics website. Principal official reference for Guangdong’s economic and social development and a key high-output coastal node.

reports.title: Jiangsu Statistical Yearbook (江苏统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Jiangsu Provincial Bureau of Statistics / NBS Jiangsu Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Jiangsu Province, one of China’s largest and most developed coastal economies. Systematically records provincial and prefecture-level data on national accounts, population, employment, prices, living standards, fixed-asset investment, foreign trade, energy, industry, agriculture, science and education. Continuously published for four decades; electronic edition released on the official statistics portal. Core high-output eastern provincial node.

reports.title: Zhejiang Statistical Yearbook (浙江统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Zhejiang Provincial Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical publication reflecting Zhejiang’s economic and social development. Covers provincial and city/county data across national accounts, population, employment, investment, foreign trade, industry, private-sector activity, living standards and social indicators. Zhejiang is a major coastal manufacturing and private-economy province; the Yearbook is the primary official statistical reference for the province.

reports.title: Shandong Statistical Yearbook (山东统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Shandong Provincial Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Shandong Province, a large coastal industrial and agricultural economy. Contains provincial and prefecture-level series on GDP and industrial structure, population, employment, fixed-asset investment, foreign trade, energy, industry, agriculture and social development. Serves as the principal official data source for Shandong’s regional accounts and sectoral performance.

reports.title: Beijing Statistical Yearbook (北京统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Beijing Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Beijing Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Beijing Municipality. Provides detailed data on national accounts, population and employment, prices, living conditions, government finance, energy and environment, fixed-asset investment and real estate, industry, services, science and technology, education and health. Reflects the capital’s high-income, service-oriented and innovation-intensive economy. Continuously published; electronic version available on the municipal statistics site.

reports.title: Shanghai Statistical Yearbook (上海统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Shanghai Survey Office
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook of Shanghai Municipality. Covers national accounts, population, employment, prices, living standards, investment, foreign trade and economic cooperation, industry, finance, real estate, science and technology, education and social statistics. Captures China’s leading international financial and trade centre. Primary official reference for Shanghai’s economic structure and high per-capita income profile.

reports.title: Sichuan Statistical Yearbook (四川统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Sichuan Provincial Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Sichuan Province, the largest economy in western China and a major inland industrial and agricultural base. Records provincial, prefecture and county-level data on national accounts, population, employment, investment, energy, resources and environment, agriculture, industry, construction, trade, science and education. Provides the principal official statistical picture of a high-output inland province for contrast with coastal peers.

reports.title: Henan Statistical Yearbook (河南统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Henan Provincial Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Henan Province, a major central-China agricultural and industrial province with large population. Covers provincial and local data on GDP and industrial structure, population, employment, investment, agriculture (including grain), industry, living standards and social indicators. Serves as the core official statistical source for Henan and as a central-region contrast node.

reports.title: Guizhou Statistical Yearbook (贵州统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Guizhou Provincial Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Guizhou Province, a relatively lower-income western province that has experienced rapid growth from a lower base. Systematically presents provincial, prefecture and county data on national accounts, population, employment, investment, foreign trade, energy, resources and environment, agriculture, industry, living conditions and minority nationality areas. Provides the official statistical baseline for western inland contrast with high-output coastal provinces.

reports.title: China City Statistical Yearbook (中国城市统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) – Department of Urban Socio-economic Surveys
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook covering socio-economic development of Chinese cities. Contains data for prefecture-level and above cities and for county-level cities on population, resources and environment, economic development (including GDP), science and technology innovation, public services and infrastructure. Distinguishes ‘whole city’ (including counties under jurisdiction) from ‘urban districts’ (shiqu). Principal national-level source for comparable city statistics; published by China Statistics Press.

reports.title: Guangzhou Statistical Yearbook (广州统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Guangzhou Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Guangzhou Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Guangzhou, the provincial capital and major economic centre of Guangdong and the Pearl River Delta. Systematically records city-wide and district-level data on national accounts (regional GDP), population, employment, investment, industry, trade, living standards and social statistics. Continuously published; electronic editions available on the municipal statistics website. Key municipal node under the Guangdong provincial layer.

reports.title: Shenzhen Statistical Yearbook (深圳统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Shenzhen Municipal Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Shenzhen, one of China’s leading special economic zones and high-tech / manufacturing hubs. Covers municipal and district data on GDP and industrial structure, population, employment, fixed-asset investment, foreign trade, industry, science and technology, and living standards. Official recurring publication of the Shenzhen statistics authority; electronic version released on the municipal government / statistics portal.

reports.title: Hangzhou Statistical Yearbook (杭州统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Hangzhou Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Hangzhou Survey Team
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Hangzhou, capital of Zhejiang and a major Yangtze River Delta digital-economy and manufacturing centre. Contains city-wide and district/county data across 13 chapters including comprehensive indicators, population and employment, industry and energy, investment, trade, finance, urban construction, science and education, and living standards. Primary official statistical reference for Hangzhou.

reports.title: Chengdu Statistical Yearbook (成都统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Chengdu Municipal Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook of Chengdu, the largest city and economic centre of Sichuan and a major western China hub. Records city and district/county data on regional GDP, population, employment, investment, industry, trade, science and education, and social development. Provides the official municipal statistical picture under the Sichuan provincial layer and serves as the principal western inland city contrast node.

reports.title: Nanjing Statistical Yearbook (南京统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Nanjing Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Nanjing Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Nanjing, capital of Jiangsu and a major Yangtze River Delta industrial, educational and transport centre. Covers municipal and district data on national accounts, population, employment, investment, industry, trade, science and technology, education and living standards. Official recurring product of the Nanjing statistics system; supports vertical analysis under the Jiangsu provincial layer.

reports.title: Suzhou Statistical Yearbook (苏州统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Suzhou Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Suzhou Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Suzhou, one of China’s largest prefecture-level economies by GDP and a leading manufacturing and foreign-investment centre in the Yangtze River Delta. Systematically presents city-wide and district data on regional GDP, population, employment, investment, foreign trade, industry and living standards. Primary official statistical reference for Suzhou under the Jiangsu provincial accounts framework.

reports.title: China / NBS Contribution to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: NBS role as data contributor and periodic compiling institution for the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication (JSP) and its Snapshot editions. China has led compilation in multiple years (including the 2011 and 2022 issues). Supplies national series on population, national accounts, prices, labour and living standards, industry, energy, agriculture, external sector and related domains that feed the comparable tables of the JSP. Not a separate statistical survey; it is the institutional contribution channel linking the Chinese statistical system to the BRICS NSO work programme.

reports.title: PBOC Payment System Report (支付体系运行报告)
reports.publisher: People's Bank of China (PBOC)
reports.description: Recurring official report on the operation of China’s payment systems. Covers bank accounts, non-cash payment instruments, volume and value of transactions processed by PBOC CNCC systems (HVPS, BEPS, IBPS, CFXPS), commercial-bank systems, UnionPay, NetsUnion and related platforms. Since the expansion of the e-CNY pilot, successive editions and quarterly updates have included cumulative and period statistics on digital yuan (e-CNY) transaction volumes, wallet openings and application scenarios. Primary official statistical vehicle for e-CNY activity figures released by the central bank.
reports.cadence_note: Annual full report plus quarterly updates

reports.title: Digital RMB (e-CNY) Transaction and Wallet Statistics
reports.publisher: People's Bank of China (PBOC)
reports.description: Official statistics on the digital yuan (e-CNY / digital RMB). Includes cumulative and periodic transaction volumes and values, number of personal and institutional wallets opened, number of authorised operating institutions, pilot locality coverage, and selected application scenarios (retail, public services, wages, taxes, cross-border pilots). Data are released primarily through the PBOC Payment System Report series, dedicated briefings by PBOC governors/deputy governors, and occasional special announcements on operator expansion. Not a standalone yearbook; the recurring statistical content is embedded in the payment-system reporting framework.
reports.cadence_note: Embedded in quarterly/annual Payment System Reports; additional ad-hoc releases on major expansions

reports.title: China County Statistical Yearbook (中国县域统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) – Department of Rural Socio-economic Surveys
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook covering China’s county-level and township-level administrative units. Published in two volumes: (1) County/City volume (县市卷) covering ~2 000+ counties, banners, county-level cities and reporting urban districts with indicators on population, regional GDP, fiscal revenue/expenditure, agriculture, industry, education, health and social security; (2) Township volume (乡镇卷) covering ~30 000 townships with basic data on area, population, industrial enterprises and commercial outlets. Primary official source for statistical data on settlements in the ~50 000-population range and the broader county tier. Data exclude Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan Province.

reports.title: China Mineral Resources Report / National Mineral Resources Reserves Statistics (中国矿产资源报告 / 全国矿产资源储量统计)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Natural Resources of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Official annual (or periodic) report and accompanying statistical tables on China’s mineral resources. Covers discovered mineral types, remaining recoverable reserves of energy minerals (coal, oil, natural gas, etc.), metallic minerals (iron, copper, rare earths, tungsten, tin, molybdenum, gold, etc.) and non-metallic minerals. Includes production rankings, changes in reserves, exploration progress, mine ecological restoration and policy updates. Complements the NBS Energy Statistical Yearbook by providing the reserves and resource-base side of China’s dual role as major producer and consumer of critical minerals.
reports.cadence_note: Annual report; reserves tables updated with reference-year lag

reports.title: China Natural Resources Bulletin (中国自然资源公报)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Natural Resources of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Annual official bulletin summarising the state of China’s natural resources. Includes land, mineral, water, forest and other resource statistics, with a dedicated section on major mineral-resource reserves and changes. Provides high-level official numbers that are consistent with the more detailed Mineral Resources Report and the national energy/mineral statistical system.

reports.title: Urban Surveyed Unemployment Rate and Related Labour-Force Indicators
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly and annual surveyed urban unemployment rate (城镇调查失业率) released by NBS, together with related labour-market indicators including rates for local vs non-local household registration, 31 major cities, age groups, average weekly hours worked, and annual migrant-worker totals. Principal official high-frequency labour-market series under the labour-force survey framework. Published in monthly national economy press releases and annual statistical communiqués / yearbooks.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly rate; annual averages and migrant-worker stock in year-end releases

reports.title: National Education Development Statistical Bulletin (全国教育事业发展统计公报)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Annual official statistical bulletin on the development of education at all levels in China. Covers number of schools, educational personnel, full-time teachers, student enrolments by type and level (pre-primary, compulsory, senior secondary, higher education, special education, vocational), non-government education, and related indicators. Primary titled recurring product of the Ministry of Education statistical system; detailed tables also released as educational statistics data series.

reports.title: China Health Statistical Yearbook (中国卫生健康统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Health Commission of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook on the development of China’s health sector and the health status of the population. Systematically compiles national and provincial data on medical and health institutions, health personnel, health facilities, health expenditure, medical services, primary health care, traditional Chinese medicine, maternal and child health, disease control, causes of death, medical security and related indicators. Principal official health-statistics yearbook.

reports.title: China Rural Statistical Yearbook (中国农村统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook systematically recording national and provincial rural socio-economic data. Covers rural basic conditions and production conditions, agricultural ecology, rural investment, gross output value and value-added of agriculture/forestry/animal husbandry/fishery, major crop and livestock production, rural markets and prices, agricultural product trade, costs and returns, rural income and consumption, rural culture/education/health and social services, state farms, and regional rankings. Complements the grain-production bulletin and county-level yearbook with a full rural–agricultural statistical picture.

reports.title: Ministry of Finance Public Finance / Budget Execution Statistics (财政收支与预算执行统计)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Official fiscal statistics compiled and released by the Ministry of Finance. Include monthly and annual general public budget revenue and expenditure (central and local), government-managed funds, state capital operations budget, national and central government deficit/balance figures, and SDDS-aligned general government operations tables. Primary source for China’s public-finance aggregates; data appear in monthly fiscal releases, annual budget execution reports to the National People’s Congress, and SDDS tables.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly fiscal revenue/expenditure releases; annual budget execution report and SDDS tables

reports.title: Wuhan Statistical Yearbook (武汉统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Wuhan Municipal Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Wuhan, the largest city in Central China and a major Yangtze River economic, transport and higher-education hub. Covers municipal and district data on regional GDP, population, employment, industry, investment, trade, science and education, and living standards. Primary official statistical reference for Wuhan under the Hubei provincial framework.

reports.title: Chongqing Statistical Yearbook (重庆统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Chongqing Municipal Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Chongqing, a province-level municipality and the largest city by administrative area in China. Records city-wide and district/county data on regional GDP, population, employment, industry, investment, trade and social statistics. Because Chongqing is a province-level municipality its yearbook simultaneously serves municipal and provincial roles; the dual ‘whole city / urban districts’ coverage is especially important given the large rural counties included in headline aggregates.

reports.title: Xi’an Statistical Yearbook (西安统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Xi’an Municipal Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Xi’an, the capital of Shaanxi and the principal economic and cultural centre of Northwest China. Covers municipal and district data on national accounts, population, employment, industry, investment, trade, science and education. Provides the key western inland city node complementary to Chengdu.

reports.title: China Contribution and Host-Country Role in the New Development Bank
reports.publisher: Government of the People’s Republic of China / People’s Bank of China / Ministry of Finance
reports.description: China’s role as founding member, equal shareholder and host country of the New Development Bank (NDB). Encompasses the Headquarters Agreement (Shanghai), capital subscription and paid-in contributions, the large China country portfolio (sovereign and non-sovereign operations), local-currency (RMB) lending share, and ongoing coordination through the Ministry of Finance and PBOC. Not a separate statistical survey; it is the institutional contribution and host-country channel linking Chinese fiscal/monetary authorities to the NDB work programme and annual reporting.
reports.cadence_note: Continuous; reflected in NDB annual reports and China portfolio evaluations

dependencies.basis: The National Accounts chapter of the China Statistical Yearbook presents the annual GDP series, industry value-added breakdowns and related aggregates that are the final verified outputs of the national accounts compilation process.
The Prices chapter of the Yearbook compiles and presents the annual CPI series and related price indices that originate from the monthly CPI releases.
Population totals, age/sex structure, urban-rural and other demographic indicators in the Yearbook are benchmarked to the most recent population census and inter-censal sample surveys.

The People's Livelihoods chapter draws directly on the household income and expenditure survey results for per-capita disposable income, consumption expenditure and related living-standard indicators.

The opening General Outlook section of each annual Statistical Communiqué presents the preliminary annual GDP figure and growth rate that are the product of the national accounts preliminary accounting.
Industrial production and value-added growth rates reported in the Communiqué are drawn from the monthly industrial value-added series.

Quarterly and annual GDP by production approach incorporates industrial value-added growth as a major component of secondary-industry estimates.

dependencies.basis: Household final consumption expenditure in the national accounts is informed by the household survey data on consumption expenditure.
The Implementation Regulations specify survey management, standards and publication rules that govern production of the Yearbook and other NBS outputs.
Annual average or year-end PPI movements summarised in the Statistical Communiqué are aggregated from the monthly PPI series.
Fixed-asset investment growth and structure reported in the Communiqué draw directly from the monthly FAI releases.
Total retail sales of consumer goods and online retail figures in the Communiqué are compiled from the monthly retail-sales series.
Grain output and agricultural production figures in the Communiqué are taken from the National Grain Production Bulletin and related agricultural surveys.
Merchandise trade totals and growth rates in the Communiqué are based on Customs statistics.
The Prices chapter of the Yearbook presents annual PPI series derived from the monthly industrial producer price indices.
Energy production, consumption and intensity tables in the China Statistical Yearbook draw on the detailed balances and series compiled for the Energy Statistical Yearbook.
Resources and Environment chapters of the Yearbook incorporate air, water, waste and ecological indicators from MEE/NBS environmental statistics.
Gross fixed capital formation in the national accounts is informed by the Fixed-Asset Investment series (with conceptual and coverage adjustments).
Household final consumption expenditure estimates draw on retail sales and household survey data as key source indicators.
Net exports of goods in the expenditure-side national accounts are derived primarily from Customs merchandise trade statistics (with BOP adjustments).
The goods account of the Balance of Payments is compiled from Customs trade data, adjusted for coverage, valuation and ownership-transfer differences under BPM6.
Industrial value-added at current prices incorporates producer price movements; constant-price industrial growth uses PPI deflators among other price indicators.
Real-estate development investment is a major component of overall Fixed-Asset Investment; the dedicated real-estate series provides the detailed property-sector contribution to FAI.
R&D investment intensity is explicitly defined as the ratio of R&D expenditure to GDP; intensity figures are therefore calculated from the national accounts GDP series.
The National Accounts and regional tables of the China Statistical Yearbook present the official provincial Gross Regional Product series compiled under the national accounts framework.
Selected city indicators and urban development data in the China Statistical Yearbook draw on the more detailed city-level series compiled for the China City Statistical Yearbook.
Many of the detailed national series published in the China Statistical Yearbook are the same series supplied in summarised form to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.
Selected county-level aggregates and rural indicators appear in summarised form in the China Statistical Yearbook regional and rural chapters.
Labour-force and unemployment series appear in the employment and population chapters of the China Statistical Yearbook.
